overview_description.description: AVELIN AI builds distributed, sovereign AI infrastructure that allows enterprises to retain absolute ownership over their data, models, and compliance frameworks . Built specifically for highly regulated sectors—such as defense, government, financial services, and healthcare—the platform ensures that no corporate telemetry or sensitive training inputs leave the organisation's internal perimeter .
